text: Handling deadlines well depends on good time management. First, make a clear plan and divide large tasks into smaller steps, so you can track your progress. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent work first and avoid wasting time on unimportant tasks. If a project grows too big, use scope management — agree with others on what is really necessary and what can wait. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early instead of hiding it. People understand delays better when you speak honestly and offer solutions.
